GITAM Deemed to be University

Multidisciplinary education & research — 110 programmes across 14 disciplines. The Visakhapatnam campus is the founding campus and main hub, at Gandhi Nagar, Rushikonda, set between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal.

Campus sports infrastructure

  • Cricket ground with practice nets
  • Professional-grade basketball court and a throwball court
  • State-of-the-art gymnasium

How to reach

Getting to GITAM Visakhapatnam

Three starting points, one destination — Rushikonda.

A · BY AIR

Bhogapuram Airport

53 min TWO-WHEELER

Route: Bhogapuram Airport → Modavalasa → Tallavalasa → Yendada → GITAM. Pre-booked cab or taxi from the terminal.

Live route ↗
R · BY RAIL

Visakhapatnam Railway Station (VSKP)

37 min TWO-WHEELER

Route: Station Road → NH16 / Beach Road north → Rushikonda. Cab or auto; city buses via Maddilapalem.

Live route ↗
B · BY BUS

RTC Complex / Dwaraka Bus Station

28 min TWO-WHEELER

Route: North via Maddilapalem towards Rushikonda. Cab or auto; APSRTC city buses towards Rushikonda.

Live route ↗
